entries.en: to return, go back; to come back

entries.zh: 归一；合多为一、归于一体
entries.en: to be reduced into one; many things brought together into one

entries.zh: 归路而行；归向正道、归于德行〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: to bring oneself back to virtue; to return to the right path [uncertain]
entries.notes: M栏“行”字读法互疑（guiā/ǔiā）且两音节T99污损；汉字“歸路行”与西语 reducirse a la virtud（归于德行）对应不密，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 归并作一伙；合群结伙、聚为一群
entries.en: to band together as one group, like companions
entries.notes: 汉字“佐/作”互疑，併、一、夥三音节T99污损；按“歸併作一夥”解作聚合成群。

entries.en: to refine as gold; to smelt, boil down
to roast, bake over fire; to refine by roasting

entries.zh: 无官职、无实任；（军中）去职无任之军官
entries.en: reformado: an officer without command; stripped of office
entries.notes: 汉字“椿”疑为“樁/官”之讹且T99污损，M栏 sungobiērn 似为 sin gobierno（无职任）之音写；17世纪西语 reformado 指失部伍而无实职之军官。

entries.en: to rub with the hands; to scrub
entries.notes: 汉字“捝/捛”互疑、M栏 gur/cur 互疑并T99污损；按西语 refregar con las manos（用手揉搓）立义。

entries.zh: （用手）揉搓、搓擦〔汉字“跣”与西语义不合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to rub with the hands; to scrub [Chinese gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 汉字“跣（赤足）/踠”与西语“用手揉搓”义不合，M栏T99污损，疑串行或误录，对应存疑。

entries.en: to rub with the hands; to knead, wash

entries.zh: 戒口；守口慎言、约束口舌
entries.en: to restrain one's mouth; to guard one's speech, hold one's tongue
entries.notes: M栏“口”字声调T99污损；语义由西语 refrenar la boca 与“戒口”互证立义。

entries.zh: 犒赏、赏赐；（士兵的）犒劳饷赏〔对应存疑〕
entries.en: to reward, recompense; refreshment or pay given to soldiers
entries.notes: R栏为西语 premiar galardonar（奖赏），汉字“詰/誥”互疑、M栏两处T99，“Có geny cô nang”难解；按R栏与西语立“犒赏”义。

entries.zh: 疼惜、抚爱；爱抚〔字形存疑〕
entries.en: to cherish, caress; to spoil with affection
entries.notes: 汉字“態/慈”互疑，M栏 im/um 与 xum 均存疑并T99污损；按西语 regalar/acariciar（疼爱、爱抚）立义。

entries.en: to entertain, treat a guest hospitably
entries.notes: M栏 wan tay / teng tay / gezü-nü 三式难解且多处T99污损；按汉字“待”与西语 regalar al huésped（善待宾客）立“待客”义。
